content:
incident-bot: PAGE: oncall (lisa-oncall). Canary alert: model service 'rwd-gen-13b-qv3' canary -> 2.3x increase in 5xx (502/504) and 1.8x tail latency for token generation. Canary traffic %: 2.5%. See runbook: /runbooks/model-canary-failures

lisa-oncall: on it. starting quick triage. Does anyone know which deployment rolled? @sam-ml any recent canary push? :eyes:

sam-ml: I kicked the canary at 1873999800 with quantization profile qv3 and new KV cache tweak (kv-evict=aggressive). Canary config: pool=rwd-gpu-p2, model=rwd-gen-13b, variant=qv3, weight=0.025. No other infra changes.

priya-sre: ack. tagging oncall channel and opening a tmp incident doc. Can we get customer impact numbers quickly? ops-bot, run query for 5xxs by customer for last 20m on rwd-gen-13b-qv3 canary hosts.

ops-bot: Query results for window [1873999800 - 1874000000]: total 5xx=124, affected customers=7, top affected: cust-omega (46 errors), cust-lumen (22), cust-nimbus (14). Error class breakdown: 502 (58), 504 (61), 500 (5).

julian-support: I already received two support pings from cust-omega (prod traffic). They reported blank responses and timeouts starting ~10:03 UTC.

maria-eng: quick hypothesis: aggressive KV cache eviction increased cache misses, causing more KV-cache fill on-hot-path and higher latency -> upstream proxy timeouts. Also possible memory regression causing OOMs and 5xx. Looking at canary host logs now.

sam-ml: adding canary diffs from the rollout: 
```diff
- quant_profile: qv2
+ quant_profile: qv3
+ kv_cache_policy: aggressive-evict
```
Also changed kernel selector to 'auto-lex' to try new fused-ops.

priya-sre: sharing timeline in-thread for quick RCA: 
- 1873999800: canary rollout started (2.5% traffic)
- 1873999865: first spike in 5xx seen on canary hosts
- 1873999920: support ticket from cust-omega
- 1873999968: incident-bot threshold breached -> page
- 1874000000: oncall thread created

lisa-oncall: thanks. Can we attach a few log snippets showing the 504s and any kernel OOM traces? Sam/maria?

maria-eng: paste from canary host rwd-canary-07:/var/log/inference.log around spike:
```
[INFO] 10:03:12 request_id=abc123 model=rwd-gen-13b variant=qv3 tokens=120 latency=1.2s
[WARN] 10:03:13 request_id=def456 model=rwd-gen-13b variant=qv3 kv-cache-miss
[ERROR] 10:03:14 request_id=ghi789 proxy=frontend upstream_timeout=60s -> 504
[ERROR] 10:03:14 oom-killer invoked? process inference_worker pid=32145 killed due to memory pressure
```
Not all hosts show OOM but a subset did.

sam-ml: also saw an uptick in kernel memory allocations after the fused-ops switch. Perf summary from canary group (aggregate): p99 latency token-gen 2.8s (baseline 1.1s), avg memory RSS +18%.

evan-product: customer impact summary for support: cust-omega experienced 40 failed requests in 10m; cust-lumen reported degraded latency. Are we rolling back the canary? We need a short customer note template if we escalate.

lisa-oncall: recommendation: immediate rollback of canary to qv2 and pin production to last stable variant while investigation continues. Priya, can you execute rollback and pin? Also enable a temporary mitigation: increase proxy timeout to 90s for canary hosts to reduce 504 noise while rollback proceeds.

priya-sre: executing rollback now. rolling canary back to variant=qv2 on pool rwd-gpu-p2. Also creating a pin in config: model:rwd-gen-13b pinned_version: qv2 for prod tenants until RCA complete. Will update when done.

ops-bot: Rollback command executed at 1874000150 by priya-sre: `deploy rollback rwd-gen-13b --variant qv2 --scope=canary`. Status: success on 6/6 canary hosts. Pin added: /config/model_pins/rwd-gen-13b=qv2.

maria-eng: after rollback, canary 5xx rate dropped within 2 minutes. Observed p95 latency back to baseline. Evidence: post-rollback window [1874000160 - 1874000300] 5xx=8.

sam-ml: adding hypothesis tracker in-thread: 
- H1 (likely): kv-cache aggressive eviction + fused-ops introduced higher memory churn -> some workers OOM -> 5xx/504s.
- H2 (possible): quant_profile qv3 regression in kernel leading to slow token generation for some seq lengths.
- H3 (unlikely): upstream infra/networking flake coincidentally timed with rollout.
Actionables: reproduce locally with qv3 + aggressive evict, run memprof; smoke test fused-ops disabled; run canary with gradated rollout and memory limits.

lisa-oncall: good. Priya, keep pin until we confirm fix. Evan, please prepare a short customer-facing note for the affected tenants summarizing impact and mitigation. Julian, loop back to cust-omega with ETA 1h for followup.

evan-product: draft note: "We've observed intermittent failures and timeouts affecting generation for some requests. We rolled back the recent canary variant and pinned the stable version. We're investigating root cause; we'll follow up with a technical summary and timeline within 1 business day." Approving?

julian-support: sending interim message to cust-omega now. Also requested logs and request IDs from their side to correlate.

priya-sre: creating incident postmortem doc stub and assigning owners: 
- triage & rollback: priya-sre (done)
- reproduction & root cause: sam-ml + maria-eng
- customer comms: evan-product + julian-support
- long-term fix (kernel/quant): sam-ml + eng-runtime

maria-eng: quick checklist for next 48h: 
- reproduce memory/OOM locally with qv3 + kv-evict=aggressive (sam)
- run A/B canary with fused-ops disabled to isolate kernel change (sam)
- add memory headroom guard to canary pools or lower canary weight (priya)
- add additional metrics: per-worker RSS, kv-cache-miss-rate, fused-op latency (observability)

sam-ml: I can repro locally on a smaller infra with qv3+aggressive eviction. Will push a repro link and memory flamegraph to the incident doc by EOD.

lisa-oncall: closing the urgent page since rollback succeeded and customer initial comms started. Keeping thread open for RCA coordination. If anything new pops up, re-page. :white_check_mark:

incident-bot: Incident state: mitigated -> rollback successful. next: RCA in 24-72h. Assigned tags: canary, kv-cache, qv3, rollback.

priya-sre: created postmortem ticket INC-2026 and linked incident doc. Follow-ups scheduled: deep-dive with runtime team tomorrow 1400 UTC.

maria-eng: adding one more note: check version pin propagation for Dedicated customers (dedicated config might not respect pin path). Priya, can you confirm that Dedicated deployments picked up the pin?

priya-sre: confirmed: Dedicated deployments use a different pin namespace. I pushed matching pin to /config/dedicated/model_pins/rwd-gen-13b=qv2. Verified via API: GET /config/dedicated/model_pins -> shows qv2.

sam-ml: uploading a short canary-diff artifact (repro logs + flamegraph) to incident doc: https://redwood-internal/s/incident/1874000000/artifacts.

evan-product: thanks everyone. I'll coordinate the customer update with julian and post it once wording is approved.

lisa-oncall: great work. We'll reconvene in the RCA meeting. Leaving notes here for the timeline and hypothesis. Thread will remain open for updates.

julian-support: closing loop with cust-omega: they acknowledged the rollback and accepted the interim message; will confirm if errors stop on their side and share more logs if needed.

-- end of thread --
